text:
Xiomara Vargas  
Senior Security Engineer | SentinelGuard Cybersecurity Solutions  
Email: xiomara.vargas@sentinelguard.com | Tel Aviv, Israel | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/xiomara-vargas  

Professional Experience  
As a senior security engineer, I have focused on building resilient systems and mitigating risks across distributed environments. At CloudSafe Technologies, I led the redesign of compliance frameworks to align with SOC2 and GDPR standards, which reduced audit findings by 40% within six months. My work involved collaborating with legal and IT teams to ensure data handling practices met regulatory requirements while enabling seamless user access. Earlier, at NetDefend LLC, I spearheaded security audits that uncovered critical vulnerabilities in legacy infrastructure, prompting a 30% improvement in patching efficiency. These audits also established standardized checklists that became part of the company’s onboarding process.  

In my role as a security analyst at CyberShield Inc., I developed threat models for cloud-based applications, which helped prioritize defenses against zero-day exploits targeting API endpoints. This approach led to a 25% reduction in incident resolution time during a major breach simulation. I also contributed to refining incident response protocols, ensuring teams could isolate and contain threats within 15 minutes of detection. My focus on application security, particularly through OWASP guidelines, resulted in the implementation of automated scanning tools that cut production vulnerabilities by 60% over two years.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity, University of California, Berkeley (2018). Graduated with honors, emphasizing coursework in cryptographic protocols, network defense, and ethical hacking. My thesis explored the intersection of identity management and PKI, which later influenced cross-team architecture decisions at CloudSafe Technologies.  

Technical Skills  
Compliance frameworks such as SOC2 and GDPR are integral to my workflow, especially in environments handling sensitive data. At NetDefend, I integrated compliance checks into CI/CD pipelines, ensuring continuous adherence to regulatory standards. Security auditing is a recurring task, where I’ve developed custom scripts to automate log analysis and detect anomalies in real-time. Threat modeling has been central to designing secure microservices, particularly in scenarios requiring zero-trust principles.  

Application security remains a core focus, with ownership of OWASP Top 10 remediation efforts that improved application resilience. For instance, at CyberShield, I led the migration of authentication mechanisms to OAuth 2.0, reducing unauthorized access attempts by 75%. Incident response has involved orchestrating multi-team efforts during high-severity breaches, including a case where I coordinated with external forensics teams to recover encrypted data within 24 hours.  

Network security has required balancing performance with protection, such as optimizing firewall rules to block 98% of known malicious traffic while maintaining low latency. Penetration testing has often preceded major system launches, uncovering critical flaws that prevented potential data leaks. My work with SIEM tools like Splunk has enabled real-time monitoring of 10,000+ endpoints, significantly enhancing detection capabilities.  

Vulnerability management is a continuous process, with a particular emphasis on prioritizing risks based on business impact. At CloudSafe, I introduced a dynamic risk scoring model that streamlined remediation efforts. Encryption and PKI have shaped identity infrastructure, including mentoring junior engineers on certificate lifecycle management. IAM systems are another area where I’ve influenced cross-functional teams, ensuring access controls align with both security and operational needs.  

Projects  
Led the development of a centralized vulnerability management platform, integrating tools like Qualys and Nessus to automate reporting and remediation tracking. This reduced manual effort by 50% and improved transparency across teams.  

Publications  
Contributed to a peer-reviewed paper on zero-trust architectures in hybrid clouds, published in the Journal of Cybersecurity (2023).  

Certifications  
Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), (ISC)², 2021. Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), 2020.
